content.text: Section 18 fully matches the preferred position — no redline needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a full vendor insurance clause that meets the preferred position on every material line: commercial general liability at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional errors and omissions at USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5M (appropriate given Vendor hosts and processes Customer Data), and workers' compensation as required by law. The coverage runs throughout the term plus one year, matching the model language. Section 18.2 adds evidence obligations that exceed the preferred ask: certificates of insurance and evidence of coverage on request, reputable insurers, primary-to-Customer coverage where commercially customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. All obligations run against the Vendor and benefit us, so no redline is warranted.
